description: SIMULATED. Three simulators on separate loopback IPs: snap7 S7-315 at 127.0.0.2:102, cpppo 5069-L320ER at 127.0.0.3:44818, pymodbus M221 at 127.0.0.4:502. Over ~190 s the client 127.0.0.1 polls Modbus FC3 every 2 s and S7 DB1 every 10 s, and runs each identity query twice.

capture.method: Npcap loopback capture via eval/sim/capture_lo.py, converted to Ethernet by eval/sim/sim_lab.py convert
actions_performed: t+0 FC3 polling (93 reads, unit 1) and S7 DB1 read polling (19 reads) start
capture.notes: Identities: snap7 fixed S7-315 identity; cpppo.cfg; modbus_server.py (see the single-protocol truths). MACs are synthetic (02:00:00:00:00:<last IP octet>): the Npcap loopback capture (link type 0) has no Ethernet header, so eval/sim/sim_lab.py convert rewrote each frame as Ethernet. Identity values come from the simulator config, not real hardware. Reproduce: eval/sim/RECORD.md.

source.vendor: client scripts eval/sim/*_query.py on the same PC; no identity
implied by S7comm + 6ES7 order number (SZL carries no vendor string)
source.hostname: SZL 0x001C reply frame #56 module_name=CPU 315-2 PN/DP (as_name=SNAP7-SERVER); fixed in the native snap7 library, not configurable

source.model: ListIdentity product_name frames 135, 141, 438, 444; CIP GAA frames 149, 153, 452, 456
source.firmware: rev 33.011 in the same frames (cpppo.cfg Product Revision 2849)
source.serial: 60E1F4A2 in the same frames (cpppo.cfg Serial Number 1625420962)
source.alt_ids: cpppo ignores the CIP route path, so the GAA routed to backplane slot 0 is answered by the same simulated controller; slot0 is not a separate module
